fit_note: Training-free uncertainty-gated zoom: sample candidates, crop sized by prediction variance, re-ground once.
Human-assist system rewriting live DOM on user request; closest to mixed-initiative user involvement, not agent-decided asking.
Builds global environment memory from random-walk exploration, composes tasks from neighbouring/related functionalities; plus learner-expert policy switching.
Uncertainty-driven planning-mode switch plus MCTS over candidate actions scored by an LLM evaluation agent; real-search, not simulation.
One model proposes several click candidates, renders them on the screenshot and critiques/ranks them; both roles co-trained with GRPO.
Completion gate plus separate MLLM judge rejects unsupported done claims; tiered loop breaker forces strategy change; search agent.
Benchmark of interstitial GUI dynamics plus agent that clusters screen-recording frames into captioned key frames as history; also C22-like benchmark.
Trains a CUA that explores a UI and outputs a usability score; agentic judge of interfaces, not trajectories.
Step-level small-to-large model cascade; learned stuck monitor plus milestone-triggered verification by a stronger model. Compute routing is main idea.
Breadth-first site exploration; complex tasks synthesised from executed action chains, then refined with trace hints; SFT.
